   - Motivation: capture oversold reversals following downside-volatility shocks.

(R_{20,t}-\operatorname{median}_{CS}(R_{20,t}))

Construction:

\[
F_{i,t} =
\operatorname{shift}_1

R_{i,t}^{20}

\begin{cases}
+1, & \Delta VIX_{t}^{10} \le 0\\
-1, & \Delta VIX_{t}^{10} > 0
\end{cases}
\right]
\]

The factor applies momentum during falling or stable VIX regimes and reverses its direction when VIX is rising. VIX is used only as an observation-only macro signal, and all inputs are lagged.

Signal construction:

\[
\frac{R_{80}}{\sigma_{60}}
\times
\frac{|\overline{r}_{40}|}{\overline{|r|}_{40}}

where:

- \(\sigma_{60}\) is trailing 60-day daily-return volatility;
- the second term rewards directional consistency over the latest 40 days;
- the signal uses only information available through the prior completed trading day.
